vb_textbox.text: Good day, there are 4 gnomes, a red, a purple, a green and a brown. When you choose one and a basket appears for you to drop the mushrooms in, observe if the mushrooms displayed is increasing or descreasing and choose the gnome that gives the higher number of mushrooms more. I think the Purple in particular gives higher mushrooms when picked. You also need to be fast when pressing either S or K while picking the gnomes and proceedto press the space bar quickly to drop into the basket once the mushrooms are being dsplayed else you lose it
